items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 para os competidores, pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA; 3. Atentar-se ao cronograma da competição. Este ano, por conta da prova do ENEM no dia 12/11, optamos por colocar as modalidades mais tradicionais e normalmente com maior número de inscritos no primeiro dia de competição (11/11, sábado). Atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus respectivos cortes/limites; 4. Caso queira adquirir a camiseta do campeonato, entre em contato com o organizador através do email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. Para informações adicionais verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador via email (welbertmoutta@gmail.com). **ENGLISH** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules; 3. Pay attention to the competition schedule. This year, due to the ENEM test on 11/12, we chose to put the more traditional events and usually with the highest number of competitors on the first day of competition (11/11, Saturday) Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 4. If you want to purchase the championship t-shirt, contact the organizer via email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com).

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Information tab. Since this will be a very small competition ALL competitors are expected to contribute to the successful execution of the competition by scrambling, judging, and or running.

items.information: This is a twin competition together with [Zottegem Morning 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ZottegemMorning2023) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzhYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--63de4aa9b1fe90f9c4af2cc3b2e86ed03f17ffda/warning.png) #You can only compete in the morning OR in the afternoon. #You can NOT compete in both competitions.
